what: A 10px dot and 20px ring, normally invisible, take the mouse position directly, and the lagging feel comes from transition (dot .3s ease-out-cubic · ring .8s expo-out). Over links and buttons the dot grows into a 40px accent-color circle (transparent .6) and a white arrow (↗) appears in the ring’s place. data-cursor="image" Over a row the dot grows into a 240px round photo window at the upper right showing that row’s photo (data-cursor-label). Leaving the window turns it off in .6s (none below 1024px or on touch)
